renderer: Microsoft Word hidden COM export; pypdfium2 rasterization at 1.65 scale
inspection_scope: All 23 page PNGs opened individually at original resolution; six contact sheets also reviewed.
findings: The initial render exposed the built-in Title style bottom border and split field/value cards. A targeted formatting-only repair removed the border and keeps each card together.
After the fix, every page was inspected at original resolution; no clipping, overlap, broken tables, or unreadable glyphs were found.
